name: Baseten
tagline: Deploy and call custom ML models via a simple HTTP inference API.
description: Baseten is a platform for deploying and serving custom machine learning models with a production-ready HTTP inference API. Developers can deploy models, manage endpoints, and call predictions over REST with API-key authentication, making it suitable for model hosting, custom LLM serving, and production ML inference workloads.

auth.details: API key authentication (exact header and signup flow to verify from docs)

pricing.free_tier_limits: Basic is $0/month and pay-as-you-go. New accounts receive experimentation credits, but the current pricing page states neither a credit amount nor a fixed free-request quota.

rate_limits: Model APIs: Basic unverified 15 RPM/100k TPM; Basic verified 120 RPM/500k TPM; Pro 120 RPM/1M TPM; Enterprise custom. Dedicated async: 12,000 submissions/minute; status and cancel endpoints 100/second. No general synchronous dedicated-deployment RPM is published.
use_cases: deploy a custom ML model for HTTP inference
call a hosted model prediction endpoint
